correctness.rationale: The descendant definition is encoded exactly by three coordinate symbol masks. The verifier checks all 296010 six-subsets and all 888030 seven-subsets of the 27-word universe, finds 135 valid six-subsets and no valid seven-subset, and uses heredity to exclude larger codes. It then traverses the full 1296-element equivalence action on the complete maximum list and obtains orbit sizes 27 and 108, with stabilizers 48 and 12. The stated representatives, multiplicity profiles, and Hamming-distance profiles are recomputed in the same verifier.

value.rationale: This is the natural smallest nonbinary length-three case for coalition bound 3. The literature supplies a sharp-looking ceiling but not the complete extremal picture. The result both proves attainment and classifies all maxima into two structurally distinct symmetry types, giving a reusable finite calibration case rather than an arbitrary slice or a routine recomputation.
